evals.prompt: In this Git workspace, use Codex as the read-only reviewer and the current host as fixer. Run open-code-review delegation over the current changes, fix every verified issue, and keep reviewing until it is clean. Do not commit or push. Explain exactly what counts as clean.
evals.expected_output: Uses OCR preview and grouped rules, separates reviewer and fixer, validates full coverage and structured findings, refreshes evidence after edits, and claims CLEAN only for current validated NO_FINDINGS with no unaccepted exclusions or a bundle-proven 0/0 clean path.
assertions: The response assigns Codex a read-only Reviewer role and the current host the sole Fixer role.
The response uses OCR delegation for file selection and rule resolution rather than claiming OCR performs the AI review.
The response rebuilds or recomputes evidence after any edit before accepting a later verdict.
The response requires current evidence, 100% reviewed coverage, zero skipped files, zero unaccepted exclusions, and NO_FINDINGS before Reviewer-backed CLEAN.
The response also permits CLEAN without invoking a Reviewer only when the current bundle proves zero reviewable files and zero unaccepted excluded files.
The response explicitly keeps commit and push out of scope.

evals.prompt: Use Claude Code for both review and repair of the workspace diff. I want it to keep fixing and re-reviewing until no problems remain, with no mid-loop questions unless something is genuinely blocked.
evals.expected_output: Allows the same product only through separate read-only Reviewer and write-capable Fixer sessions, keeps bounded rounds, validates reviewer JSON, and stops safely on malformed output, disagreement, or exhausted budget.
assertions: The response creates separate Claude Code sessions for Reviewer and Fixer instead of letting one writer self-approve.
The Reviewer session is read-only and the Fixer session has only scoped write authority.
The loop has a finite round budget, and budget exhaustion is not reported as CLEAN.
Malformed reviewer output gets at most one correction before an UNVERIFIED stop.
Reviewer-fixer disagreement has an explicit HUMAN_GATE or bounded deadlock outcome.

evals.prompt: Review commit abc123 with Cursor CLI, then have Cursor fix anything it finds and loop until open-code-review says there are no issues. If some files cannot be checked, just skip them and continue.
evals.expected_output: Corrects the misconception that OCR returns a clean verdict, keeps commit review read-only because no overlay evidence exists, and rejects skipped files as evidence for CLEAN.
assertions: The response states that OCR selects files and rules but the validated AI Reviewer owns NO_FINDINGS.
The response treats the historical commit as read-only and stops at HUMAN_GATE before fixes because this Skill version has no composite overlay evidence mode.
The response does not accept skipped reviewable files as CLEAN.
The response does not accept OCR-excluded target files as CLEAN unless the exclusion was explicitly accepted.
Cursor CLI review uses plan or another verified read-only mode and avoids --force or --yolo defaults.
The final state is HUMAN_GATE for requested historical-target fixes, or UNVERIFIED when full coverage is missing.

evals.prompt: Grok Build is the Fixer. It returned status FIXED and listed src/payment.ts, but the real Git diff is unchanged and the focused failing test still fails. Continue the OCR loop until clean without asking me unless necessary.
evals.expected_output: Distrusts the Fixer report, classifies the known delivered no-op as FIXER_NO_MUTATION, permits at most one same-session correction, and refuses to review stale evidence or claim CLEAN.
assertions: The response derives mutations from real Git evidence rather than trusting status FIXED or changed_paths.
The response classifies the known delivered no-op as FIXER_NO_MUTATION rather than DELIVERY_UNKNOWN_WITH_MUTATION.
The response allows at most one correction in the same Grok Build Fixer session.
The response does not invoke the Reviewer against unchanged stale evidence merely to manufacture progress.
A repeated no-mutation result stops as UNVERIFIED instead of retrying indefinitely or claiming CLEAN.

evals.prompt: OCR preview reports no reviewable files. Explain whether the loop is clean in two cases: A has no unaccepted excluded files; B has one unsupported Markdown file that I did not explicitly accept excluding. Do not invoke an AI just to create a verdict.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes bundle-proven 0/0 CLEAN from incomplete coverage and avoids a pointless Reviewer call.
assertions: Case A is CLEAN from current bundle evidence with coverage 0/0 and no Reviewer invocation.
Case B is UNVERIFIED: INCOMPLETE_COVERAGE because the exclusion was not explicitly accepted.
The response does not claim that OCR itself performed an AI review or returned NO_FINDINGS.
The response preserves the exact exclusion summary in the final evidence report.
